description: This file defines the ShoppingCartDao interface, which provides data access methods for ShoppingCart entities, including retrieval and removal operations based on different identifiers.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDao
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao to handle data operations for ShoppingCart entities, including retrieval by ID, customer, code, and removal.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by its unique ID within a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by its unique code within a merchant store.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by ID without collection objects.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by code without collection objects.
